title: BI Agent — A2A Result Output Schema
description: Schema for the 'output' field in A2AResult when BI Agent task completes.

message.description: Human-readable answer formatted for the user (Vietnamese)

generated_sql.description: SQL query that was executed (for transparency). Present when status = success.

limit_applied.description: True if automatic LIMIT was injected into the query

data.description: Raw result rows as objects. Present when status = success and row_count > 0.

error_reason.description: Present when status = rejected or error. English description of why the query was rejected or failed.

examples.message: Doanh thu hôm nay: 2,850,000đ từ 23 đơn hàng.
examples.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(total) as revenue, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 100

examples.message: Tôi chỉ có thể truy vấn dữ liệu, không thể sửa đổi. Vui lòng thử lại với câu hỏi khác.
examples.error_reason: Non-SELECT SQL rejected: DELETE statement detected
